owner_calls.question: Genosha (and its Interim Council, on which Emma sits) is destroyed by the Sentinel attack in X-Men '97 S1 episode 5. Does that end the group for her (Independent/left after it, like S.H.I.E.L.D.'s fall), or does Genosha continue (in S2 episode 6 Xavier goes to its ruins and bases X-Corp there)?
options: Keep Genosha as her last stage
Add left 'X-Men '97 S1' (Genosha's fall ends the group)
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database lists the Interim Council as a former affiliation and calls her S2 life a 'solo career'; in S2 episode 2 she acts on her own, leading X-Force into X-Factor's trap. Wikipedia: Xavier 'travels to the ruins of Genosha' and bases the team there in S2 episode 6.
